reason: Every AI tool on LinkedIn says it plugs into everything, and then it turns out my invoicing and booking tools aren't on the list. I might poke at the free plan, but I'm not putting 99 euros a month on the card until I've seen it actually work with my own setup.
objection: "CRM, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365..." doesn't tell me if it connects to the specific tools I use every day. And 100 credits a month means nothing to me, so I can't tell whether that covers a week of work or a whole month.
would_change_my_mind: A clear list showing my exact tools are supported, plus a plain explanation of what 100 credits actually gets me, then a free month on my own data where it saves me real hours.
